mentions.name: joseflys
mentions.description: Open-source suite of aviation tools that performs all flight computations client-side, covering the math from private pilot ground school and serving as a replacement for the E6-B flight computer, including navigation calculations shareable via example links.
mentions.problem: Serves as a way to learn ground school math and as a replacement for the physical E6-B flight computer.
mentions.audience: Student pilots doing ground school for their private pilot license
mentions.source_excerpt:
I started a project involving several aviation tools while doing ground school for my private pilot license. It started as a way of learning the maths, and a replacement for the E6-B computer.

It is opensource, all the computations are done on the client side,
